dataset: H-1B LCA and PERM disclosure data
fields_used: employer name; job title; SOC code; offered wage; worksite; case status; PERM employee count, citizenship, education
license_or_usage: US government public data. Accessed through the Hugging Face mirror Nason/dol-visas-database (mirror terms per its dataset card, not independently verified)
limitations: Filings are applications by US employers for foreign-national workers; a proxy for US hiring not headcount. Mirror not re-checked against the original DOL files. FY2026 partial

dataset: Federal prime contract awards and subawards
fields_used: recipient; awarding agency; award value; start date; NAICS; PSC; subaward fields
limitations: Prime and sub awards in the federal system only; recipient search is fuzzy and results are filtered to the firms' legal entity names. Awards are dated by start year

publisher: BCG; Bain; secondary sources (Fortune; InfluenceWatch; Umbrex; Wikidata statements)
dataset: Revenue headcount offices and countries data points
license_or_usage: Facts quoted with attribution; each row carries its own URL
limitations: Only BCG publishes revenue and headcount. McKinsey and Bain figures are third-party estimates. Rows are marked verified=yes only if the source page was opened and read

dataset: Public website sitemaps (URL paths and last-modified dates only)
fields_used: URL path; lastmod; section; year in path
license_or_usage: Sitemap files named in each site's robots.txt; no page content crawled
limitations: Counts of published pages are a proxy for emphasis not revenue. McKinsey's site did not respond to automated requests and is not covered. Bain press-release pages are dominated by one region and affected by a site migration

fields_used: filing form; filer; SIC code; filing date
license_or_usage: US government public data; SEC fair-access guidance followed (identified user agent; under 10 requests per second)
limitations: A mention is not proof of a client relationship: names also appear in cited studies and director biographies. Industry mix mostly reflects the SEC filer universe

fields_used: supplier; buyer; awarded value; date; CPV
access_method: src/ingest/uk_contracts.py (quoted-phrase search windowed by publication year)
limitations: Search API has no pagination (windowed to stay under the result cap). Framework agreements list ceiling values (GBP 50M or more excluded from spend totals). Contracts under the notice threshold are absent

dataset: Proactive publication of contracts over CAD 10000
fields_used: vendor; department; contract value; date; description
access_method: streamed CSV filtered by vendor name (src/ingest/canada_contracts.py); raw file not stored
limitations: Contracts over CAD 10000 only; amendments are reported as listed

fields_used: supplier; procuring entity; contract value; date
license_or_usage: Creative Commons Attribution (see the API's license field)
access_method: weekly windows paged and filtered by supplier name (src/ingest/austender.py)
limitations: Contract notices only, above reporting thresholds; values are as notified

fields_used: work; year; type; citations; primary topic
limitations: Only McKinsey and BCG have institution records; Bain has none. Counts reflect affiliation recording not research output

fields_used: monthly user pageviews of each firm's English article
limitations: Measures public attention not business performance

fields_used: revenue; headcount statements and their reference URLs
limitations: Statements are community-maintained; used only to locate leads, each carried into S3 as an estimate with its original reference
